message.content:
{"decision": "APPLY", "workflow_yaml": "name: Lint, Test, and (Maybe) Publish

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Check out files
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Update to latest NPM version
        run: npm i -g npm
      - name: Install package dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Lint code
        run: npm run lint --if-present

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Check out files
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Update to latest NPM version
        run: npm i -g npm
      - name: Install package dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Test code
        run: npm run test --if-present
      - name: Test built entry points
        run: npm run test:build

  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    if: ${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.repository_owner == 'longshotlabs' && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    needs: [lint, test]
    permissions:
      contents: write # Clone and tag releases
      issues: write # Comment on issues
      pull-requests: write # Comment on PRs
      id-token: write # REQUIRED for OIDC Trusted Publishing
    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash
    steps:
      - name: Check out files
        uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v6
        with:
          node-version: '22'
          cache: 'npm'
          cache-dependency-path: package-lock.json
      - name: Update to latest NPM version
        run: npm i -g npm
      - name: Install package dependencies
        run: npm ci
      - name: Semantic Release
        run: npx semantic-release
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}", "rationale": "Adds a custom timeout (timeout-minutes: 5) to each job, matching the P-LIT-CUSTOM-TIMEOUT pattern and the measured experiment on a similar Node.js lint/typecheck workflow. The CI history shows successful runs complete in under a minute, so a 5-minute bound provides headroom for cold-cache installs while preventing runaway job consumption. All build, lint, test, and publish steps are preserved unchanged; no permissions, secrets, or network access are altered.", "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--fb8b16eb65a11508"]}
